mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, real_name, gender, birthday, city_name, area_name, address, longitude, latitude, bio, wallet_balance, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_profile (user_id, real_name, gender, birthday, city_name, area_name, address, longitude, latitude, bio, wallet_balance, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{realName}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{cityName}, #{areaName}, #{address}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{bio}, #{walletBalance}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user_profile SET real_name = #{realName}, gender = #{gender}, birthday = #{birthday}, city_name = #{cityName}, area_name = #{areaName}, address = #{address}, longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude}, bio = #{bio}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user_profile SET wallet_balance = COALESCE(wallet_balance, 0) + #{delta}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
